name: Fel Rock
summary: North of Dolanaar, corruption spreads through Fel Rock and threatens Teldrassil’s woods. Lord Melenas and his grells have made the once-tranquil cavern a danger.

sections.title: A Den of Corruption
sections.body: North of Dolanaar, Fel Rock lies among Teldrassil’s wooded hills. Once peaceful, the cavern is now choked by twisted roots and strange shadows. Wild grells and grellkin roam within. The taint reaches into the boughs of the world tree.

sections.title: The Satyr's Hold
sections.body: Lord Melenas, a satyr, has made Fel Rock his stronghold. From the cavern, he spreads corruption while night elf sentinels keep watch. Druids in Dolanaar, among them Tallonkai Swiftroot, seek defenders to cleanse the cave and slay Melenas. They must stop the blight before it reaches farther into the surrounding woods.

faq.answer: Fel Rock lies in the hills directly north of Dolanaar, in central Teldrassil.
Lord Melenas, a satyr, commands Fel Rock and has gathered grells to do his bidding.

faq.q: Why are druids concerned about Fel Rock?
faq.answer: A satyr and fel-tainted grells threaten Teldrassil’s natural balance. Druids such as Tallonkai Swiftroot send defenders to slay Lord Melenas and stem the corruption.

faq.q: What creatures dwell inside the cavern?
faq.answer: Aggressive grells and grellkin dwell in Fel Rock, along with their master, the satyr Lord Melenas.

angles.text: For the Kaldorei, Lord Melenas and his stronghold near Dolanaar threaten Teldrassil and demand swift retribution.
As a druid of the Cenarion Circle, you see Fel Rock’s corruption as a wound in the young world tree. It must be purged before the blight spreads.
